DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車に傷があるというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a scratch on your car, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人から借りた車です。私が今日使っていて傷に気づきましたが、いつ付いたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた友人車の傷を当日発見し発生時不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It’s a car I borrowed from a friend. I noticed the scratch while using it today, but I don’t know when it happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you discovered a scratch today on a friend’s borrowed car and do not know when it occurred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち主の方には、連絡されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡しました。持ち主は友人で、今日運転しているのは私です。友人からは、見つけた時の状況を説明してほしいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人が所有し自分が使用していることと所有者連絡済みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have. My friend is the owner, and I’m the one driving today. My friend asked me to explain the circumstances when I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend owns the car, you are using it, and you have contacted the owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 傷を見つけた場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where and when you found the scratch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買い物から戻った午後三時です。駐車場で左の後ろの傷を見つけました。借りる時は、その部分まで写真を撮っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐車場十五時左後傷と貸借時当該撮影なしを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was at three in the afternoon, when I returned from shopping. I found the scratch at the left rear in the parking lot. I didn’t photograph that part when borrowing the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found a left rear scratch in the parking lot at 15:00 and did not photograph that area when borrowing the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 何かが当たる場面や、音は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you see anything hit it or hear any sound?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 当たる所は見ていません。運転中に音がした記憶もありません。出かける前の傷の有無は確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 衝突場面と音を確認しておらず使用前の傷も未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I didn’t see anything hit it. I don’t remember hearing a sound while driving either. I haven’t confirmed whether the scratch was there before I went out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you did not see a collision or hear a sound, and have not checked whether the scratch existed before use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる事実を順番に伺います。車の情報もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We’ll ask about the facts you can confirm in order. Do you also have information about the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人から借りた書類があります。所有者は友人、今日の使用者は私と伝え、傷の写真と見つけた時刻を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所有者使用者資料と傷写真発見時刻を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have documents borrowed from my friend. I’ll explain that my friend owns it and I’m today’s user, and show the scratch photos and the time I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present documents about the owner and user, photos of the scratch, and the discovery time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お持ちの資料で状況を確認します。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We’ll check the situation using the documents you have. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外への荷物ですね。中に何をお入れになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a parcel for overseas, correct? What will you put inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へだしのパックを送りたいです。食品なので、原材料の表示を持って相談に来ました。まだ箱へ詰めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外家族宛だし食品を未梱包で原材料表示付き相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send packs of soup stock to my family. Since it’s food, I brought the ingredient label to ask for advice. I haven’t packed them in a box yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about unpacked soup stock for family overseas, bringing the ingredient label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お届け先の国と、商品の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We’ll check the destination country and the product label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送り先はベトナムです。袋のこの面に、使っている魚の名前などが書いてあります。この表示を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先国ベトナムと原材料表示面を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The destination is Vietnam. This side of the bag lists the names of the fish used and other ingredients. Please look at this label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Name Vietnam as the destination and show the ingredient label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食品は、送る方法や相手国の条件も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: For food, we also need to check shipping methods and the destination country’s conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この商品で確認をお願いします。必要なら、メーカー名や商品名もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象商品の確認を頼みメーカー名や商品名の提示も申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check this particular product. I can also provide the manufacturer and product names if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for this product to be checked and offer the manufacturer and product names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な確認先と、荷物の受付についてご案内します。数量はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We’ll explain whom to contact for the necessary checks and how the parcel is accepted. Have you decided on the quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 未開封の袋を二つ予定しています。もし確認できない所があれば、今日は発送せず、まず必要な情報を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封二袋予定で未確認なら発送せず情報を調べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I’m planning two unopened bags. If anything cannot be confirmed, I won’t ship them today; I’ll first look up the necessary information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan two unopened bags, and will research the information without shipping if anything is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにご準備ください。内容を申告する際も、食品の種類が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prepare that way. When declaring the contents, also make sure the type of food is clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 単に贈り物とだけ書かず、だしのパック二袋という内容を伝えます。送れる条件が確認できてから、梱包して持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 贈物だけでなく食品二袋の内容を申告し確認後梱包と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won’t just write “gift”; I’ll state that the contents are two bags of soup stock packs. Once the shipping conditions are confirmed, I’ll pack them and bring them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will declare the contents as two bags of food rather than only a gift, and pack them after confirming the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、表示と宛先の情報で確認いたします。少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We’ll check using the label and destination information. Please wait a little. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話の変更についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about changing your mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新しい携帯に替える予定です。銀行のアプリも使っているので、古い携帯を消す前に必要な準備を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯買替え前に銀行アプリ準備を旧端末消去前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I’m planning to get a new phone. I also use the banking app, so I’d like to ask what preparations are needed before erasing my old phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before replacing your phone, ask about banking app preparations before erasing the old device. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は、古い携帯でアプリを使えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you currently use the app on your old phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使えています。新しい携帯はまだ買っていません。店で古い方を下取りに出す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧端末利用可新端末未購入で下取予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can. I haven’t bought the new phone yet. I plan to trade in the old one at the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the old device works, you have not bought a new one, and you plan a trade-in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 引継ぎの方法は、ご利用のアプリと登録情報を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member in charge will check your app and registered information for the transfer method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下取りに出す日に間に合うよう準備したいです。先に古い携帯で済ませる手続きがあれば、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 下取り前に旧端末で済ませる銀行手続きがあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to prepare in time for the trade-in date. If there are procedures I need to complete on the old phone first, please tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether there are banking procedures to complete on the old device before trading it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 認証に使う連絡先などの確認も必要です。パスワードは、ここでおっしゃらないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need to check contact details used for authentication and other information. Please do not say your password here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: パスワードは言いません。電話番号は今のまま使う予定ですが、そのことも担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 秘密を言わず電話番号継続予定を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won’t say my password. I plan to keep my current phone number, and I’ll tell the person in charge that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Without revealing secrets, tell the staff member you plan to keep your phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 下取りの前に、案内された準備と利用できる状態をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before the trade-in, check that the preparations you were advised to make are complete and that you can use the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい携帯で使えるか確認できるまで、古い携帯を初期化するのは待ちます。まず銀行の案内を聞いてから買替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新利用確認まで初期化を待ち案内後に買替えと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ll wait to reset the old phone until I can confirm the app works on the new one. First I’ll get the bank’s instructions, then replace my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will delay resetting until confirming use on the new phone and replace it after receiving guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、アプリの担当へご案内します。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’ll take you to the staff member responsible for the app. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は済みました。袋はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Payment is complete. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持参した袋を、財布を探した時に隣の台へ置きました。商品を詰める前に戻したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布探索時に置いた持参袋を袋詰め前に回収したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the bag I brought on the next counter while looking for my wallet. I’d like it back before packing the items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to retrieve the bag you set down while looking for your wallet before packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの緑の袋でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、内側に私の名前があります。まだ商品を入れていない私の袋なので、こちらへ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名入り緑自己空袋を確認し返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my name is inside. It’s my bag, and I haven’t put any goods in it yet, so please return it to me here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the green empty bag with your name is yours and ask for it back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返しします。商品は、袋詰めの台へお持ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here you are. You can take your items to the packing counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋詰めの台へかごを運んで、そこで広げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋詰め台へかごを運び袋を広げると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I’ll take the basket to the packing counter and open the bag there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take the basket to the packing counter and open the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お財布もお持ちになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have your wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 財布はかばんへしまいました。袋は手に、商品はかごにあります。レシートも受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布収納と袋商品位置を確認しレシートを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put my wallet in my bag. The shopping bag is in my hand, and the goods are in the basket. I’d also like my receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your wallet is put away and where the bag and goods are, and ask for the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。袋詰めの後、かごは返却場所へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your receipt. After packing, please return the basket to the designated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートを財布へ入れました。商品を袋へ移したら、空のかごを返します。自分の袋を置き忘れずに済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート収納後に袋詰めし空かご返却と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the receipt in my wallet. Once I transfer the goods to the bag, I’ll return the empty basket. I managed not to leave my own bag behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pack after putting away the receipt and return the empty basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for shopping with us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃へのご参加でしょうか。皆さんの班は、先ほど出発しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you joining the cleanup? Your group left a short while ago.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めてで道に迷い、遅れました。班を探して走るより、今ここで手伝えることがあれば参加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初参加遅着で班を追走せず現地残作業を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It’s my first time, and I got lost and arrived late. Rather than running around looking for the group, I’d like to join in if there is anything I can help with here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you arrived late on your first visit and want to help with remaining work here rather than run after the group. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場所では、袋の準備と使い終えた道具の片づけが残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here we still need to prepare bags and put away the tools that have been used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋の準備から手伝います。初めてなので、置く順番と終わった物の置場を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋準備に参加し置く順番と置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I’ll start by helping prepare bags. Since it’s my first time, please tell me the order to put them in and where to put the finished ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Join the bag preparation and ask the order and where to place them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、こちらの空のごみ袋を一枚ずつ取り出して重ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, take these empty trash bags out one by one and stack them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋が二枚くっついていたので、分けて重ねます。まとめた袋は、この台の端へ置けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: くっついた空袋を分けまとめた物の置場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two bags were stuck together, so I’ll separate them before stacking. Should I put the prepared bags at this end of the table?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate stuck empty bags and confirm where to place the prepared ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、台の端へお願いします。終わったら、戻ってきた方の道具を受け取るのも手伝ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, at the end of the table, please. Once you finish, please also help receive tools from people returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返ってきた道具も、この台へそろえますね。手袋を持ってきたので、作業の前に着けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却道具を台へそろえ持参の手袋を着けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I’ll arrange the returned tools on this table too, right? I brought gloves, so I’ll put them on before working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will arrange returned tools on the table and put on the gloves you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 危ない物や汚れのある物は、ご自身で処理せずお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us about dangerous or dirty items instead of handling them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その時はスタッフへ声をかけます。空袋をそろえられました。次は台の所で道具の返却を手伝います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 危険汚れはスタッフへ知らせ袋準備後道具返却を手伝うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ll call a staff member if that happens. I’ve arranged the empty bags. Next I’ll help with tool returns at the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will notify staff about dangerous or dirty items and help with tool returns after preparing the bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋はきれいにそろっていますね。ありがとうございます。私は回収の方へ行きますので、道具を受け取る係とお願いします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The bags are neatly arranged. Thank you. I’m going to the collection area, so please work with the person receiving tools. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車に持ち込むお荷物についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about luggage to bring onto the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳み自転車です。袋に入れましたが、車輪の端が外へ出ています。このままではなく、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 輪端が露出する折畳自転車の持込を乗車前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It’s a folding bicycle. I put it in a bag, but the edge of a wheel is sticking out. I’d like to check first rather than take it on as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before boarding, ask about bringing a folding bicycle whose wheel edge is exposed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内の条件では、自転車全体を袋に収めてください。今の袋では、出ている部分を覆えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Under the conditions in this guidance, the whole bicycle must be inside a bag. Can you cover the exposed part with your current bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋が短くて、これ以上引き上げられません。全体が入る袋を用意して、別の日に持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋が短く全体を覆えないと説明し次回用に大きい袋を準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag is too short, and I can’t pull it up any further. I’ll get a bag that fits the whole bicycle and bring it another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag is too short to cover everything and say you will prepare a larger bag for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全体が収まる物をご用意ください。今から乗る予定は、変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please get one that holds the whole bicycle. Can you change your plan to board now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ち合わせに行く予定でしたが、自転車を無理に持ち込まず、家へ置いてから戻れます。相手にも遅れると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無理に乗らず自宅へ置き待合相手へ遅延連絡すると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to meet someone, but I can leave the bicycle at home and return instead of forcing it onto the train. I’ll also tell the person I’m meeting that I’ll be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose leaving the bicycle at home rather than forcing it on board, and notifying the person you are meeting of the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自転車を置いてこられるなら、戻った時の列車でご案内できます。切符はもう購入されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you leave the bicycle, we can advise you about a train when you return. Have you bought a ticket yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ買っていません。今の列車の切符を先に買わず、戻ってから出発時刻を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未購入切符を先に買わず戻った時刻で選ぶと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I won’t buy a ticket for the current train in advance; I’ll check the departure time when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not bought a ticket and will choose according to the time when you return rather than buying now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、戻られた時に行き先と時刻をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, please tell us your destination and the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は自転車を家へ置き、大きい袋の準備は別の日にします。まず待ち合わせの相手へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は自宅保管を選び大袋準備を別日にすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I’ll leave the bicycle at home and prepare a large bag another day. First I’ll contact the person I’m meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to leave it at home today and prepare a large bag another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、自転車をお持ちになってお気をつけてお戻りください。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care going back with your bicycle. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the notice you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の名前で通知が届きましたが、父は先月亡くなりました。私はこの通知の内容を確認して相談したいので、担当窓口を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 亡父宛通知と先月の死亡を伝え担当窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice arrived in my father’s name, but he passed away last month. I’d like to check its contents and discuss it, so please tell me which counter handles it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a notice addressed to your late father arrived, that he died last month, and ask the responsible counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を拝見します。亡くなられたことについての届出と、この通知の相談を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the notice. We’ll give separate guidance on reporting his death and discussing this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 死亡の届出は家族が行ったと聞いています。それだけでこの通知への対応も終わったと思ってよいか、私には分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 死亡届済みと通知対応済みを同一視できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard that a family member filed the death notification. I don’t know whether I can assume that means this notice has also been dealt with.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say a filed death notification cannot automatically be equated with this notice being handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通知は担当課で確認します。お客様とお父様の関係もお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible department will check this notice. Could you also explain your relationship to your father?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の子です。通知には支払期限がありますが、誰がどのように対応するのか、担当の方に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の子と説明し通知への対応方法を担当へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I’m his child. The notice has a payment deadline, but I’d like to ask the person in charge who should respond and how.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are his child and want to ask the responsible staff how to deal with the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当は二階の五番窓口です。通知の封筒と中の用紙を、両方お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible counter is number five on the second floor. Please bring both the envelope and the paper inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒も用紙もあります。書かれた期限までまだ数日なので、今日その窓口で相談してから、家族に内容を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知封筒用紙を持ち期限前に相談し家族へ共有すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have both the envelope and the paper. There are still a few days before the written deadline, so I’ll discuss it at that counter today and then tell my family the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the notice envelope and paper, consult before the deadline, and share the details with family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届出の状況が分かる資料は、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have any documents showing the status of the notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は通知だけを持っています。ほかに必要な資料も五番窓口で聞いて、家族に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知以外の必要資料を担当へ尋ね家族に共有すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Right now I only have the notice. I’ll ask at counter five about any other documents needed and tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the responsible staff about documents needed besides the notice and share that with family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、五番窓口へご案内します。それでは、こちらから二階へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’ll direct you to counter five. Please go up to the second floor from here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診の用紙をご記入ください。連絡先の欄もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please fill out the first-visit form. There is also a contact information section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は日本の携帯電話をまだ持っていません。隣の友人の番号を書いてよいか聞きたいです。友人にはまだ頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本携帯未所持で未承諾友人番号の記入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don’t have a Japanese mobile phone yet. I’d like to ask whether I can write the number of the friend beside me. I haven’t asked my friend yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have no Japanese mobile phone and ask about entering a friend’s number without having obtained consent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人の承諾なしに記入せず、まずお話しください。ご自身で受けられる連絡方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don’t enter it without your friend’s consent; please talk to them first. Is there a way we can contact you directly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールなら自分で見られます。海外の電話番号もありますが、日本で確実に受けられるかは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己メールは利用でき海外番号は着信未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can check email myself. I also have an overseas phone number, but I haven’t confirmed whether I can reliably receive calls in Japan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can use your own email but have not confirmed incoming calls on your overseas number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使える方法について担当へ確認します。ご友人にも、お電話を受けて連絡を伝えられるかお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I’ll ask the person in charge what methods can be used. Please also ask your friend whether they can take calls and pass messages to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今聞きました。友人は今日だけ付き添いで、普段の連絡を受けるのは難しいそうです。その番号は書かないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は普段の取次困難と確認し番号を使わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I just asked. My friend is accompanying me only today and says it would be difficult to receive routine messages. I’ll leave their number off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend cannot routinely relay messages and do not use the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。メールの扱いと連絡先の記入について、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I’ll pass the questions about email use and filling in contact information to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で確認できるメールはこちらです。担当の方に、この方法で連絡を受けられるか聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が確認できるメールを提示し利用可否の担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Here is the email address I can check myself. Could you ask the person in charge whether I can receive messages this way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the email you can check yourself and ask staff to confirm whether it can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認するまで、電話番号の欄は空けてください。お名前など、ほかの欄は記入できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave the phone number field blank until the person in charge checks. Can you fill in the other fields, such as your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかは書けました。電話の欄に友人の番号を勝手に入れず、使える連絡方法を担当と確認して用紙を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話欄を保留し他欄記入済で担当確認後仕上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ve filled in the others. I won’t put my friend’s number in the phone field without permission; I’ll finish the form after confirming a usable contact method with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the other fields are filled in and the phone field will wait until staff confirmation before you finish the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでご案内をお待ちください。それでは、担当へ連絡します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here for guidance. I’ll contact the person in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われたお財布ですね。拾った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a wallet you found, correct? Please tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪場の入口です。この角が破れていますが、私が拾う前から、地面にこのような状態で落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐輪場入口で拾う前から財布角に破れがあったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At the bicycle parking entrance. This corner is torn, but it was already lying on the ground in this condition before I picked it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the wallet’s corner was already torn before you picked it up at the bicycle parking entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った時に中身が外へ出ていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Were any contents outside it when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小銭が二枚、財布のすぐ横にありました。財布と一緒に持って来ましたが、もともとこの財布の中の物かまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横の二硬貨も持参したが財布由来は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There were two coins right beside the wallet. I brought them along with it, but I don’t know whether they originally came from inside this wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought the two adjacent coins but do not know whether they came from the wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 財布と小銭の発見位置を、それぞれ伺います。中を開けて調べましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We’ll ask separately where you found the wallet and the coins. Did you open it and check inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けていません。二枚の小銭は別の小袋へ入れ、財布の中へ戻してはいません。位置を紙に描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で硬貨は別袋とし発見位置を描く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven’t opened it. I put the two coins in a separate small bag rather than putting them back in the wallet. I’ll draw their positions on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is unopened, the coins are in a separate bag, and draw where you found them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 描いてください。こちらで発見時の状態として記録します。届ける途中のことも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please draw it. We’ll record this as the condition when found. Also tell us about the journey here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手提げの中で別の荷物に押されないように持って来ました。途中で落としたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手提げ内で押されないよう保護し途中で落とさなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought it in a tote bag so other belongings would not press against it. I haven’t dropped it on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you protected it from pressure inside a tote bag and did not drop it on the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご連絡先も伺います。傷の原因について、ご存じのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We’ll also ask for your contact information. Do you know anything about the cause of the damage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原因は見ていません。拾った時にはすでに角が破れていたことと、小銭が横にあったことを、私が見た事実としてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 破損原因を推測せず目撃した二事実だけを届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I didn’t see the cause. I’ll report as facts I observed that the corner was already torn when I found it and the coins were beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report only the two observed facts without guessing the cause of damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発見時の状態を確認しました。それでは、財布と別袋をお預かりします。お届けありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the condition when found. We’ll take the wallet and separate bag now. Thank you for handing them in. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居のお手続きについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on moving-address procedures, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と子どもは同じ新しい家へ移りますが、私は今月、子どもは来月に引っ越します。全員を今月の同じ日で書いてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ新居でも親今月子来月の転居日を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child and I are moving to the same new home, but I will move this month and my child next month. I’m unsure whether I can write the same date this month for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about different moving dates: the parent this month and the child next month, despite the same new home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 移る日が異なることを、分けて確認します。お子様は来月まで今の住所に住む予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We’ll separately check the fact that your moving dates differ. Will your child live at the current address until next month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。学校の都合で、祖母と今の家に残ります。子どもの郵便は、まだ今の家で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子は祖母と旧宅に残りその郵便受取を継続希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Because of school, my child will stay at our current home with their grandmother. I still want my child’s mail delivered to the current home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child will stay at the old home with their grandmother and you want their mail to continue arriving there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お客様の分とお子様の分の希望を担当へ伝えます。祖母様も新しい住所へ移られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I’ll tell the person in charge your preferences for yourself and your child. Will the grandmother also move to the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 祖母は移りません。新しい家へ行くのは、今月の私と来月の子どもです。祖母の名前を対象へ入れないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 祖母は転居せず対象に入れないと限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The grandmother is not moving. The people going to the new home are me this month and my child next month. I don’t want the grandmother’s name included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify that the grandmother is not moving and must not be included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの時期と対象者を確認できるよう、こちらへ予定をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write your plans here so we can confirm the two different times and the people concerned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の今月の予定と、子どもの来月の予定を分けて書きました。新住所は同じですが、開始希望の日は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共通新住所と別々の希望開始日を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote my plans for this month and my child’s for next month separately. The new address is the same, but our requested start dates differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter the shared new address and separate requested start dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がその内容で必要な手続きを確認します。お子様の資料についてもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the procedures needed for those details. We’ll also advise you about your child’s documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。一枚に同じ日を入れて済ませず、誰がいつ移るかを伝えてから、必要な用紙を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員同日を避け対象者時期を担当確認して用紙を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Rather than putting the same date for everyone on one sheet and leaving it at that, I’ll explain who moves when, then prepare the necessary forms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid the same date for everyone, confirm the people and timing with staff, and prepare the forms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご相談内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらでご案内をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23230-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’ll pass your consultation details to the person in charge. Please wait here for guidance. Excuse me.
